subject: a persimmon branch against open sky
art_direction: 一枝橘红柿子从下方斜伸，少量黄叶映着灰蓝晴空。
visible_description: 一枝橘红柿子从下方斜伸，少量黄叶映着灰蓝晴空。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Frame one persimmon branch diagonally across the lower half against a smooth gray-blue autumn sky. Three orange fruits and a few yellow leaves create a restrained rhythm, with subtle skin bloom and leaf veins visible nearby. Use gentle side light and soft distant focus. Keep the branch natural and unadorned, suggesting quiet abundance without an orchard full of fruit. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
